user.title: Add Sagemcom DSIW74 decoder
user.description: Connect to the local CANAL+ decoder API and configure the HDMI encoder, media player to follow and editable channel presets. A media-player channel name can automatically trigger a preset with the same name.

init.title: DSIW74 settings
init.description: Edit HDMI encoder credentials, source media player and channel presets. When automatic sync is enabled, a media-player channel name matching a preset automatically tunes the corresponding DSIW74 channel.
